# Lovable Documentation

> Lovable Documentation — Build full-stack websites with AI using natural language. Explore Lovable features, integrations, tutorials, and best practices.

- [Lovable API](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/lovable-api.md): Use the Lovable API to deploy Lovable projects, manage your workspace, query security scans, and embed projects in your product.
- [Lovable MCP server](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/lovable-mcp-server.md): Connect AI agents and developer tools to Lovable using the Model Context Protocol. Build, iterate, and deploy apps programmatically.
- [Build with URL](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/build-with-url.md): Build and share Lovable apps from simple URLs, with reference images and web pages.
- [View and edit your project's code](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/code-mode.md): Open the code editor in Lovable to browse and search your app's source code, make manual edits, reference exact lines in the project chat, and download your codebase.
- [Project settings](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/projects/settings.md): Every Lovable project setting in one reference: rename a project, change its URL, control publishing and sharing, connect Git, manage domains, or delete a project.
- [Email authentication for your app](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/email-auth.md): Configure email sign-in for your app's built-in backend (Cloud): confirmation, password rules, one-time codes, and sending limits.
- [Phone authentication for your app](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/phone-auth.md): Let users sign in to your app with their phone number and an SMS one-time code, using your own SMS provider.
- [Add Google authentication to your app](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/google-auth.md): Add Google authentication to your app using managed Google OAuth or your own Google Cloud credentials.
- [Add Apple authentication to your app](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/apple-auth.md): Add Sign in with Apple to your app using managed Apple OAuth or your own Apple Developer credentials.
- [Add Microsoft authentication to your app](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/microsoft-auth.md): Add Microsoft sign-in to your app using managed Microsoft OAuth or your own Azure app registration.
- [Secrets](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/secrets.md): Store API keys and other sensitive values securely in your app's built-in backend (Cloud), and understand the difference between secrets and VITE_ environment variables.
- [Logs](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/logs.md): Debug errors and track activity in your app with searchable built-in backend logs across functions, database, auth, and storage.
- [AI features for your app](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/ai.md): Add AI features like chatbots, summaries, and image generation to your Lovable app with the built-in AI connector. No API keys or provider setup required.
- [Security overview](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/security.md): Protect your apps with built-in security scans, API key protection, database access checks, dependency audits, and optional security integrations.
- [Lovable connectors: Connect tools, services, and APIs](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/introduction.md): Connect Lovable to external tools, services, and APIs. Choose between app + chat connectors, chat connectors, and app user connectors, or integrate any API.
- [Create a custom connector](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/create-connector.md): Build your own connector for any REST API, public or internal, and make it available to your Lovable workspace. Define the endpoint, authentication, and knowledge once, and let everyone in your workspace connect to it like any other app connector.
- [Integration security](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/security.md): How Lovable stores and protects integration credentials, plus the gateway, IP allowlisting, and domain restrictions that secure connector traffic.
- [Connect your app to Perplexity](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/perplexity.md): Connect your app to Perplexity, an AI search and answer engine, to return cited answers from live web, academic, and financial sources. Use Lovable's managed connection for web search, or your own API key for the full Perplexity API.
- [Connect to Supabase](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/supabase.md): Connect Lovable with Supabase for seamless backend setup, database, auth, storage, real-time, and serverless functions.
- [Connect your app to Microsoft Fabric](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/microsoft-fabric.md): Connect your app to Microsoft Fabric to query Lakehouses, Warehouses, SQL databases, and mirrored databases through Fabric's API for GraphQL.
- [Connect your app to Snowflake](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/snowflake.md): Connect Snowflake to your Lovable app using Snowflake OAuth. Run SQL, use the SQL REST API, and work with warehouses and data from your Snowflake account through Lovable's connector gateway.
- [Connect your app to GatewayAPI](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/gatewayapi.md): Connect your app to GatewayAPI, an SMS and RCS messaging API, to send mobile messages, track delivery status, and handle inbound replies from your Lovable app.
- [Connect your app to Resend](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/resend.md): Connect your app to Resend, an email API for developers, to send transactional and marketing emails from your own verified domain.
- [Connect your app to Cloudflare API](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/cloudflare-api.md): Connect your app to Cloudflare with an API token to inventory zones and DNS records, build traffic and security dashboards, manage DNS, purge cache, and operate Workers, R2, and KV.
- [Connect your app to GitHub API](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/github-api.md): Connect your app to GitHub by signing in with your GitHub account or with a personal access token, to read repositories, manage issues and pull requests, and build automations with the GitHub REST API.
- [Connect your app to GitLab API](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/gitlab-api.md): Connect your app to GitLab.com, GitLab Self-Managed, or GitLab Dedicated to work with projects, issues, merge requests, pipelines, and repository files through the GitLab REST API.
- [Connect your app to the Lovable API](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/lovable-api-connector.md): Connect your app to the Lovable API to list and manage projects, publish, embed project previews, and read analytics, members, and security insights for a connected Lovable workspace.
- [Connect your app to Google Maps Platform](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/google-maps.md): Connect Google Maps Platform to your Lovable app to geocode addresses, calculate routes, search places, embed interactive maps, and pull location data like weather and air quality, using a managed connection or your own API keys.
- [Connect your own Stripe account](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/stripe.md): Accept one-time payments and subscriptions with a Stripe account you own. Lovable builds the checkout through chat using your Stripe API key.
- [Connect your app to Microsoft 365](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/microsoft.md): Connect Microsoft Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote to your Lovable app. All use the same Microsoft sign-in and Microsoft Graph pattern, so one guide covers every Microsoft connector.
- [Connect your app to WordPress (self-hosted)](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/wordpress.md): Connect your app to a self-hosted WordPress site to read and manage posts, pages, media, and users through the WordPress REST API.
- [Integrate any API with Lovable](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/any-api.md): Connect any external service to your Lovable app, even ones without a built-in connector. Describe the API in a prompt and Lovable writes the integration, storing keys safely in the built-in backend (Cloud).
- [Add payments to your app](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/payments.md): Accept subscriptions and one-time payments in any Lovable app using built-in Paddle or Stripe integration.
- [Create and manage API keys](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/api-keys.md): Create, scope, and revoke workspace API keys (access tokens) for the Lovable API, and set per-key credit limits.
- [API basics](https://docs.lovable.dev/api-reference/introduction.md): All the basics to get started with the Lovable API.
- [API changelog](https://docs.lovable.dev/api-reference/changelog.md): Track stable versions and changes to the Lovable API.
